subject.title: macOS app: dashboard fails silently with unresolved ${OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN} placeholder when env var not in app's environment, with no in-app recovery path

question: Which linked PR should become the canonical fix path for the macOS dashboard auth placeholder lockout?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but multiple open PRs overlap the same root cause and differ on whether they fix the macOS resolver, gateway auth, LaunchAgent env-file parsing, or only the URL error path.

options.title: Use the strongest macOS resolver PR
options.body: Review and land the linked macOS resolver candidate with current-head real macOS proof, then close the duplicates after merge.

options.title: Choose another linked candidate
options.body: Select a different open PR if it has cleaner upgrade behavior, stronger proof, or a better owner-boundary fix.

options.title: Ask for a replacement only if candidates stall
options.body: Keep this issue open and request a narrow replacement only if none of the linked PRs can be made landable.

recommendation.title: Use the strongest macOS resolver PR
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked macOS resolver candidate with current-head real macOS proof, then close the duplicates after merge.
